title: Get a free taco from Taco Bell

asr.full_text: Happening today, thanks to Taco Bell's steal a base, steal a taco promotion,. All of America gets a free taco. Washington National shortstop Trey Turner swiped second base. During the first inning of game one of the World Series. This is the fifth year in a row everyone won a free taco from this deal. Not just any taco, it's the Doritos Locos taco. You can pick yours up from 2 p.m. until 6 p.m. today.
